parameters.query:
SELECT input1.id, input1.updatedDate, input1.name, input1.url, input1.uploader
FROM input1
LEFT JOIN input2 ON input1.id = input2.documentId
WHERE input2.documentId IS NULL
   OR input2.lastProcessedDate IS NULL
   OR input2.lastProcessedDate = ''
   OR input1.updatedDate > input2.lastProcessedDate
